relationship_to_rd8: separate diagnostic; RD8's frozen criterion, denominator and NOT_REPRODUCED outcome are unchanged and not re-decided by this run

input.order_definition: frozen RD8 complete_orders; frame order preserved inside each episode

oracle.definition: float64 two-pass full-array mean and population std

d1_vs_frozen_rd8.note: D1 re-executes the unmodified pinned reducer on the same verified projections; exact agreement with the archived per-condition errors is the control that the diagnostic instrument reproduces the frozen replay before any variant is read
